sources.notes: The review is restricted to training or adapting robot representations, policies, and world models with paired visual and tactile/force data; pure tactile hardware and inference-only sensing are adjacent rather than direct evidence.

queries.label: dynamic-visuotactile-joint-training
queries.query: all:((visuo-tactile OR vision-tactile) AND (training OR learning)) AND all:(robot AND manipulation)
queries.why: Capture papers that explicitly train on visual and tactile streams rather than merely adding a touch sensor at deployment.

queries.label: dynamic-visuotactile-world-model
queries.query: all:((visuo-tactile OR vision-tactile) AND world AND model) AND all:(robot OR manipulation)
queries.why: Cover action-conditioned joint prediction of visual and contact futures.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-vla-grounding
queries.query: all:(tactile AND (VLA OR vision-language-action) AND (grounding OR action)) AND all:robot
queries.why: Find tactile supervision injected into VLA representations or action experts.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-distillation
queries.query: all:(tactile AND distillation AND (vision OR VLA)) AND all:(robot OR manipulation)
queries.why: Cover training-time tactile supervision that is distilled into a deployable visual policy.

queries.label: dynamic-contact-gated-asymmetric-fusion
queries.query: all:(tactile AND (gated OR asymmetric) AND fusion) AND all:(robot OR manipulation)
queries.why: Capture selective fusion intended to prevent tactile inputs from corrupting visual dynamics.

queries.label: dynamic-visuotactile-reflex-control
queries.query: all:((visuo-tactile OR vision-tactile) AND (reflex OR high-frequency OR residual)) AND all:(robot AND control)
queries.why: Cover slow visual planning plus fast tactile residual correction in closed loop.

queries.label: dynamic-visuotactile-benchmark-generalization
queries.query: all:((visuo-tactile OR touch-vision) AND (benchmark OR dataset OR generalization)) AND all:robot
queries.why: Cover paired-data scale, contact-sequence leakage, held-out materials, and closed-loop evaluation boundaries.

queries.label: dynamic-missing-tactile-negative-transfer
queries.query: all:(tactile AND (missing-modality OR negative-transfer OR contamination)) AND all:(robot AND manipulation)
queries.why: Search counterevidence on sensor absence, unstructured fusion, and deployment mismatch.
